```complex_dependency
import pytest
import asyncio
import time
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch, AsyncMock
import h2.events
import h2.exceptions
from .._backends.base import AsyncNetworkStream
from .._exceptions import ConnectionNotAvailable, LocalProtocolError, RemoteProtocolError
from .._models import Origin, Request, URL, Response
from .._synchronization import AsyncLock, AsyncSemaphore
from .http2 import (
    has_body_headers,
    HTTPConnectionState,
    AsyncHTTP2Connection,
    HTTP2ConnectionByteStream
)

@pytest.fixture
def mock_origin():
    return Origin(scheme=b'https', host=b'example.com', port=443)

@pytest.fixture
def mock_stream():
    stream = Mock(spec=AsyncNetworkStream)
    stream.read = AsyncMock(return_value=b'')
    stream.write = AsyncMock()
    stream.aclose = AsyncMock()
    return stream

@pytest.fixture
def test_request(mock_origin):
    return Request(
        method=b'GET',
        url=URL(scheme=b'https', host=b'example.com', port=443, target=b'/'),
        headers=[(b'host', b'example.com')],
        stream=AsyncMock()
    )

@pytest.fixture
def test_post_request(mock_origin):
    return Request(
        method=b'POST',
        url=URL(scheme=b'https', host=b'example.com', port=443, target=b'/submit'),
        headers=[(b'host', b'example.com'), (b'content-length', b'10')],
        stream=asyncio.Queue()
    )

@pytest.fixture
def h2_connection(mock_origin, mock_stream):
    with patch('httpcore.http2.h2.connection.H2Connection') as mock_h2:
        mock_h2_instance = Mock()
        mock_h2_instance.get_next_available_stream_id.return_value = 1
        mock_h2_instance.data_to_send.return_value = b''
        mock_h2_instance.local_flow_control_window.return_value = 65535
        mock_h2_instance.max_outbound_frame_size = 16384
        mock_h2_instance.local_settings.max_concurrent_streams = 100
        mock_h2_instance.state_machine.state = h2.connection.ConnectionState.OPEN
        mock_h2.return_value = mock_h2_instance
        conn = AsyncHTTP2Connection(origin=mock_origin, stream=mock_stream, keepalive_expiry=30.0)
        yield conn

# Test helper function has_body_headers
def test_has_body_headers():
    # Normal case with content-length
    req1 = Mock(headers=[(b'Content-Length', b'100')])
    assert has_body_headers(req1) is True
    # Normal case with transfer-encoding
    req2 = Mock(headers=[(b'Transfer-Encoding', b'chunked')])
    assert has_body_headers(req2) is True
    # Boundary case no body headers
    req3 = Mock(headers=[(b'Host', b'example.com'), (b'User-Agent', b'test')])
    assert has_body_headers(req3) is False
    # Case-insensitive check
    req4 = Mock(headers=[(b'CONTENT-length', b'50')])
    assert has_body_headers(req4) is True

# Test connection initialization
def test_connection_init(mock_origin, mock_stream):
    conn = AsyncHTTP2Connection(origin=mock_origin, stream=mock_stream, keepalive_expiry=30.0)
    assert conn._origin == mock_origin
    assert conn._state == HTTPConnectionState.IDLE
    assert conn._sent_connection_init is False
    assert conn._request_count == 0
    assert conn._used_all_stream_ids is False
    assert conn._connection_error is False

# Test can_handle_request
def test_can_handle_request(h2_connection, mock_origin):
    # Same origin
    assert h2_connection.can_handle_request(mock_origin) is True
    # Different scheme
    wrong_scheme = Origin(scheme=b'http', host=b'example.com', port=443)
    assert h2_connection.can_handle_request(wrong_scheme) is False
    # Different host
    wrong_host = Origin(scheme=b'https', host=b'example.org', port=443)
    assert h2_connection.can_handle_request(wrong_host) is False
    # Different port
    wrong_port = Origin(scheme=b'https', host=b'example.com', port=8443)
    assert h2_connection.can_handle_request(wrong_port) is False

# Test state check methods
def test_state_checks(h2_connection):
    assert h2_connection.is_idle() is True
    assert h2_connection.is_available() is True
    assert h2_connection.is_closed() is False
    assert h2_connection.has_expired() is False
    # Test expired state
    h2_connection._expire_at = time.monotonic() - 10
    assert h2_connection.has_expired() is True
    # Test closed state
    asyncio.run(h2_connection.aclose())
    assert h2_connection.is_closed() is True
    assert h2_connection.is_available() is False

# Test info and repr
def test_info_repr(h2_connection, mock_origin):
    info_str = h2_connection.info()
    assert str(mock_origin) in info_str
    assert 'HTTP/2' in info_str
    assert 'IDLE' in info_str
    assert 'Request Count: 0' in info_str
    repr_str = repr(h2_connection)
    assert 'AsyncHTTP2Connection' in repr_str
    assert 'IDLE' in repr_str

# Test normal GET request flow
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_handle_get_request(h2_connection, test_request, mock_stream):
    # Mock events
    response_event = h2.events.ResponseReceived()
    response_event.stream_id = 1
    response_event.headers = [(b':status', b'200'), (b'content-type', b'text/plain')]
    data_event = h2.events.DataReceived()
    data_event.stream_id = 1
    data_event.data = b'hello world'
    data_event.flow_controlled_length = 11
    end_event = h2.events.StreamEnded()
    end_event.stream_id = 1
    h2_connection._h2_state.receive_data.return_value = [response_event, data_event, end_event]
    mock_stream.read.side_effect = [b'', b'']

    response = await h2_connection.handle_async_request(test_request)
    assert response.status == 200
    assert dict(response.headers) == {b'content-type': b'text/plain'}
    assert response.extensions[b'http_version'] == b'HTTP/2'
    # Read response body
    body = b''
    async for chunk in response.content:
        body += chunk
    assert body == b'hello world'
    # Verify write calls
    assert mock_stream.write.called
    assert h2_connection._h2_state.send_headers.called
    assert h2_connection._request_count == 1

# Test POST request with body
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_handle_post_request(h2_connection, test_post_request, mock_stream):
    # Populate request body
    await test_post_request.stream.put(b'hello')
    await test_post_request.stream.put(b'world')
    test_post_request.stream.put_exception(StopAsyncIteration())
    # Mock response events
    response_event = h2.events.ResponseReceived()
    response_event.stream_id = 1
    response_event.headers = [(b':status', b'201')]
    end_event = h2.events.StreamEnded()
    end_event.stream_id = 1
    h2_connection._h2_state.receive_data.return_value = [response_event, end_event]
    mock_stream.read.return_value = b''

    response = await h2_connection.handle_async_request(test_post_request)
    assert response.status == 201
    assert h2_connection._h2_state.send_data.call_count == 2
    assert h2_connection._h2_state.end_stream.called

# Test wrong origin error
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_wrong_origin_error(h2_connection):
    wrong_req = Request(
        method=b'GET',
        url=URL(scheme=b'https', host=b'wrong.com', port=443, target=b'/'),
        headers=[],
        stream=AsyncMock()
    )
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match='Attempted to send request to'):
        await h2_connection.handle_async_request(wrong_req)

# Test connection not available when closed
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_closed_connection_error(h2_connection, test_request):
    await h2_connection.aclose()
    with pytest.raises(ConnectionNotAvailable):
        await h2_connection.handle_async_request(test_request)

# Test no available stream IDs error
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_no_available_stream_ids(h2_connection, test_request):
    h2_connection._sent_connection_init = True
    h2_connection._max_streams_semaphore = AsyncSemaphore(100)
    h2_connection._h2_state.get_next_available_stream_id.side_effect = h2.exceptions.NoAvailableStreamIDError()
    with pytest.raises(ConnectionNotAvailable):
        await h2_connection.handle_async_request(test_request)
    assert h2_connection._used_all_stream_ids is True
    assert h2_connection._request_count == 0

# Test remote protocol error on connection terminate
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_remote_protocol_error(h2_connection, test_request):
    term_event = h2.events.ConnectionTerminated()
    term_event.error_code = 2
    term_event.last_stream_id = 0
    h2_connection._connection_terminated = term_event
    with pytest.raises(RemoteProtocolError):
        await h2_connection.handle_async_request(test_request)

# Test local protocol error
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_local_protocol_error(h2_connection, test_request):
    h2_connection._sent_connection_init = True
    h2_connection._max_streams_semaphore = AsyncSemaphore(100)
    h2_connection._h2_state.send_headers.side_effect = h2.exceptions.ProtocolError('Invalid header')
    with pytest.raises(LocalProtocolError):
        await h2_connection.handle_async_request(test_request)

# Test remote settings change
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_remote_settings_change(h2_connection):
    h2_connection._sent_connection_init = True
    h2_connection._max_streams = 100
    h2_connection._max_streams_semaphore = AsyncSemaphore(100)
    # Simulate max concurrent streams reduce
    settings_event = h2.events.RemoteSettingsChanged()
    settings_event.changed_settings = {
        h2.settings.SettingCodes.MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS: Mock(new_value=50)
    }
    await h2_connection._receive_remote_settings_change(settings_event)
    assert h2_connection._max_streams == 50
    # Simulate max concurrent streams increase
    settings_event.changed_settings = {
        h2.settings.SettingCodes.MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS: Mock(new_value=75)
    }
    await h2_connection._receive_remote_settings_change(settings_event)
    assert h2_connection._max_streams == 75

# Test byte stream close
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_byte_stream_close(h2_connection, test_request):
    h2_connection._events[1] = []
    stream = HTTP2ConnectionByteStream(h2_connection, test_request, 1)
    with patch.object(h2_connection, '_response_closed', AsyncMock()) as mock_close:
        await stream.aclose()
        assert stream._closed is True
        mock_close.assert_called_once_with(stream_id=1)

# Test async context manager
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_async_context_manager(h2_connection):
    with patch.object(h2_connection, 'aclose', AsyncMock()) as mock_close:
        async with h2_connection as conn:
            assert conn is h2_connection
        mock_close.assert_called_once()
```
